v1.0_fail_note.immutability: No v1.0 rho/checker/target is repaired after blind reveal. Any continuation requires new prereg/version and a new population freeze.
v1.0_fail_note.root_cause: v1.0 local gadgets exposed forced port values to generic whole-formula unit propagation, so mixed target formulas collapsed to one locally admitted leaf; CONTROL_CYCLE and CONTROL_WIDTH_4 also had alternate admitted structure. This violates the preregistered anti-triviality/scope challenge, despite target decisions being exact.

v1.1_calibration_fail_note.diagnosis: Frozen generic separator implementation required every post-separator clause group to contain at least 3 clauses. Valid v1.1 local gadgets (especially compact 2CNF leaves and Horn private islands) violate that heuristic, so no candidate admitted calibration formulas. Removing only the minimum-clause heuristic still exposed leaf-intersection cliques because some local gadgets fragment around the same separator.
v1.1_calibration_fail_note.disposition: v1.1 terminates. No rho frozen. No blind run. Continue only under new prereg/new independently generated population with structurally robust local gadgets; frozen transfer_core remains unchanged unless separately preregistered.

v1.1_canonical_fail_note.interpretation: The v1.1 anti-triviality population passed generator self-audit, but the frozen reusable transfer grammar could not construct any admissible exact carrier on calibration. Per prereg, no candidate may be frozen and blind execution must not proceed.

v1.1_prefreeze_repair_note.reason: no v1.1 population had been frozen and no v1.1 candidate synthesis/blind reveal had occurred
